children: Brown & Brown reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $1.73 billion, up 7.4% from a year earlier, while net income rose 5.7% to $240 million. Diluted EPS was $0.67, compared with $0.68 in the prior-year quarter.
Revenue was $1.73B, compared with $1.61B in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 7.4%.
Net income attributable to the Company was $240M, compared with $227M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 5.7%.
Diluted EPS was $0.67, compared with $0.68 in the prior-year quarter; YoY change (1.5%).
Commissions and fees rose 9.7% in the quarter, while organic revenue grew 1.2%; acquisitions contributed substantially to overall growth.
Contingent commissions increased 9.6%, supported by improved carrier underwriting results, premium growth and acquisitions.
Retail organic revenue grew 2.6%, and its adjusted operating margin edged up to 28.1%, with support from acquisition synergies and cost leverage.
Specialty Distribution organic revenue declined 0.8%. Contingent commissions partly offset the decrease, while CAT property rate declines and European capability investments weighed on margins.
The company completed 18 acquisitions in the first nine months and cited ongoing integration synergies and its decentralized sales-and-service model.
